description: Liztox is a botulinum toxin type A injectable developed by Huons Biopharma, a subsidiary of the South Korean pharmaceutical group Huons Global, and approved by Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS). It is a lyophilised, high-purity type A toxin supplied in 100 and 200 unit vials for aesthetic and therapeutic use. The same product is distributed in export markets under the Hutox brand name.
howItWorks: Botulinum toxin type A binds to presynaptic cholinergic nerve terminals and cleaves the SNAP-25 protein, blocking acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction. This produces temporary, localised chemodenervation that relaxes the injected muscle, softening dynamic wrinkles. The effect is reversible as nerve terminals recover, typically over about 3-4 months.
composition: Botulinum toxin type A (Clostridium botulinum toxin type A complex), available in 100 unit and 200 unit vials, formulated with human serum albumin and sodium chloride as excipients. Sources cite a high purity level (reported around 99.8%).
usageNotes: Supplied as a lyophilised white powder for reconstitution with preservative-free 0.9% sterile saline immediately before use. Store refrigerated at 2-8C and use the reconstituted solution promptly per label. For administration by trained practitioners only.
features: Korean type A toxin from Huons Biopharma
High reported purity, low protein load
benefits: Consistent unit potency for predictable dosing
High purity aimed at reducing immunogenic burden
Backed by a large established Korean manufacturer
Two vial sizes support flexible clinic inventory

description: Metox is a Korean botulinum toxin type A injectable manufactured by Maypharm Co., Ltd., which markets it as a second-generation, vacuum-dried toxin. It is supplied in 100 unit and 200 unit vials and is intended for professional aesthetic use. It is not FDA-approved and is not marketed for sale in the United States.
howItWorks: Botulinum toxin type A binds to presynaptic cholinergic nerve terminals and cleaves the SNAP-25 protein, blocking acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction. This temporarily relaxes the injected muscle and softens dynamic lines. The effect is reversible over roughly 3-4 months as neuromuscular transmission recovers.
composition: Botulinum toxin type A, supplied in 100 unit and 200 unit vials as a vacuum-dried powder, with human serum albumin and sodium chloride as standard excipients. Distributors describe a low-protein, high-purity (reported around 99.8%) formulation.

As Metox is vacuum-dried rather than freeze-dried, the vial may appear nearly empty or show only a faint dried film; the full dose dissolves on reconstitution. Store unopened refrigerated at 2-8C; for trained practitioners.
